title: A chamber of about 119 cm^3
summary: The chamber holds 118.8 cm^3 of air: inside the 115 to 125 cm^3 the design panel settled on, large enough to keep the window out of a throat and small enough that the finger hole stays under 8 mm as printed.

rejected.why: the quietest and breathiest of the three by the panel's estimate: 4.7 % of the oscillation loss radiated, behind a window path 17 mm long, outside every recipe in the acoustics notes

returns_if.text: when the bird has to be shorter than about 110 mm and a quieter whistle is accepted

rejected.why: its finger hole comes out at 8.1 to 8.2 mm (8.3 to 8.4 mm as drawn for print), over the 8 mm of C8 and marginal for a child; it radiates best of the three (7.4 % against 5.7 % here, both estimates) and it got its volume from flat roof strips that are bridges inside the chamber
